t: The Hager Sollysta WXPSS81 13A 1-gang outdoor weatherproof switched socket provides reliable and safe external power access for various electrical appliances. Engineered for demanding environments, this robust polycarbonate unit has a double hinge lid that opens a full 180 degrees, allowing unrestricted access for wiring, while a padlock fixing point enhances security against unauthorised use. Features 25mm knockouts located on the top, bottom, sides, and rear for versatile cable entry.
